title: Greatest Common Divisor of Strings
description:
[Source: LeetCode 1071]
For two strings s and t, we say "t divides s" if and only if s = t + t + ... + t. Given two strings str1 and str2, return the largest string x such that x divides both str1 and str2.

Input Format:
First line: str1
Second line: str2

Output Format:
Largest common divisor string or empty
